plugins.name: S&P Catalog
plugins.description: Works editor, people, society reports, royalties, and payouts. Private SQLite catalog on your host. Required. Install this first.

plugins.name: S&P App
plugins.description: Public /app/ catalog for phones and share links. Login from the header. Has its own designer. Needs Catalog.

plugins.name: S&P Sessions
plugins.description: Writing sessions: record, invite, trim audio, turn a take into a catalog work. Needs Catalog.

plugins.name: S&P Album Art Studio
plugins.description: Generate and sleeve album art for a serial. Optional. Uses the xAI key in Catalog if you have one.

plugins.name: S&P Accounting
plugins.description: Email a quarterly PDF statement from Royalties per person. Optional. Uses your host mail.
